question: Which country hosted the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The 2022 FIFA U-17** Women's World Cup was the 7th edition of the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup.
 
• Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik launched the** FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup India 2022 Host City logo.**
 
• The FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup India 2022 was held from October 11 to October 30 in Odisha, Goa, and Maharashtra.
 
• This was the first FIFA women's competition to be held in India and the first FIFA competition to be organized by the state of Odisha.
 
• The launch of the official Host City logo of Odisha was an important milestone that also reflects the progress of women's football.
 
• The official host city logo of Odisha is a composite that represents the official emblem of the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup India 2022 with a specially designed artwork that highlights the rich cultural heritage, vibrant sports ecosystem, and overall splendour of the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• 2022 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup

 
 
• Since its inception, the biennial international women's youth football championship has been contested by the under-17 national teams of FIFA's member associations. 2008.
 
• The tournament will be hosted by India, which would have hosted the 2020 edition before it was cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• This is the second time that India hosts a FIFA tournament after the men's 2017 FIFA U-17 World Cup.
 
• This is the first time India hosts a FIFA women's football tournament.
 
• Morocco and Tanzania also made their debuts along with hosts India.
